provenance.instrument: Cecil Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 240 Zoning, adopted 5-17-2000 as part of Ord. No. 5-00, amended in its entirety at the adoption of the Code, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 CE2516, Township of Cecil, Washington County (240-14J: appeals to 'the Washington County Court of Common Pleas'). The code page shows 'Code 2026-06-01'. Amendments in the sections read run to Ord. No. 3-2026 (6-1-2026), which amended 240-23 (R-1), 240-28 (C-1) and 240-48 (accessory uses). New Laws: only Ord. No. 1-2021 (pensions).
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: 'Includes legislation through 06-01-2026' (table of contents, seen in a search result summary). New Laws: Ord. No. 1-2021 (pensions) only.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar listing. Each residence district permits its listed uses 'and no other' (240-23A, 240-26A)

'In no case shall there be more than one principal building used for residential purposes located on one property, except as otherwise provided in this chapter for a mobile home park, planned development, or land development' (240-46). A single-family dwelling is 'the only principal structure on the lot' (240-8). A second home in a separate building is therefore barred

Two-family dwellings (two independent units, each with a separate entrance, the only principal building on the lot) are permitted by right in R-2, R-3 and C-3, and in the residential category of the SD District and the Interstate Highway Planned Development Overlay. In R-2 the lot needs 6,000 sq ft per unit with public sewer (21,780 per unit without), in R-3 5,000 (17,000 without). The code has no rule on converting an existing house

Accessory structures are capped by lot size, as a share of the house's livable space or a square footage, whichever is less, and a height: up to 1/2 acre 35% or 625 sq ft and 14 ft; 1/2 to 0.9 acre 50% or 1,025 sq ft and 18 ft; 1 to 2.9 acres 75% or 1,600 sq ft and 28 ft; 3 to 4.5 acres 100% or 2,000 sq ft and 30 ft; 5 acres and above 200% and 38 ft; at most two stories, all accessory structures together (240-48A, B). An older sentence left in 240-48E still says 50% of the principal building and 14 ft

C-3 permits an apartment above a business by special exception, not on the street floor (240-30C(2)). In C-2 a veterinary clinic (conditional use) may have one attached dwelling unit for the veterinarian or an assistant (240-29C(3)(b)), and a C-1 self-storage facility a dwelling for a resident manager or watchman (240-28C(10)(p)). None of these is a unit added to a house
On slopes over 25% a single-family house needs a one-acre lot, 150 ft wide, with 50 ft front, 40 ft side and 60 ft rear yards and 10% lot coverage (240-52F)
Parking: 2 spaces for a single-family dwelling, 2 per unit for a two-family dwelling (240-64B)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Cecil Township Building and Zoning Department, 3599 Millers Run Road, Cecil. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15. Searched the code (scope all, which also covers New Laws) for accessory apartment, accessory dwelling, accessory family, in-law, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, relative, housekeeping unit, caretaker, guest house, tenant house, living quarters, sleeping quarters, immediate family, watchman, separate living, cooking facilities, tiny house, caregiver, second dwelling, carriage house and farm dwelling, then two-family, duplex, conversion, converted, mobile home, manufactured home, one principal, number of buildings, lot coverage and use not. Read in full: 240-14, 240-17, Article VI from 240-22 to 240-30 and 240-38 (print, first part), 240-30 (on screen), Article VIII 240-45 to 240-55, and on screen the 240-8 definitions named in the notes, 240-34G and 240-64. Attachments 1 (Development Standards by District) and 2 (Official Schedule of Uses) are PDFs and were not opened; the district sections give uses and area and bulk figures in text. No bar on use variances was found. Not read: 240-31 to 240-33 (I-1, I-2), 240-35 to 240-37 (BPD, P, TC), 240-39 and 240-39.1, Article VII (PRD) and Article XIII (nonconformities)

term.note: No ADU term. Searches of the code for the terms listed in the notes found none

status.note: The code has no ADU text. One principal residential building per property (240-46). Two-family dwellings are permitted in R-2, R-3 and C-3

status_by_form.note: 'In no case shall there be more than one principal building used for residential purposes located on one property.' A building holding a second home would be a second residential building. A single-family dwelling is 'the only principal structure on the lot'

path.note: A second unit with a single-family house is not a listed use. It needs a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board (MPC 910.2). No section read bars a use variance. In R-2, R-3 and C-3 the building may instead be a two-family dwelling by right

fallback_path.note: Five findings of unnecessary hardship. A variance expires if no permit application is filed within two years (240-14A(4))

value.name: Two-family dwelling (R-2)
value.conditions: A two-family dwelling is 'A residential building containing two independent dwelling units, each having a separate entrance, and which is the only principal building on the lot' (240-8). Lot area 6,000 sq ft per dwelling unit with public sewer, 21,780 sq ft per unit without, so 12,000 or 43,560 sq ft for the two units. Lot width 90 ft. Front 35 ft, side 10 ft, rear 30 ft, three stories or 35 ft, lot coverage 35%. Two parking spaces per unit (240-64B)
value.note: Not an ADU listing. A building type. Whether an existing house may be altered into a two-family dwelling is not stated

value.name: Two-family dwelling (R-3)
value.conditions: A two-family dwelling is 'A residential building containing two independent dwelling units, each having a separate entrance, and which is the only principal building on the lot' (240-8). Lot area 5,000 sq ft per dwelling unit with public sewer, 17,000 sq ft per unit without, so 10,000 or 34,000 sq ft for the two units. Lot width 75 ft. Front 25 ft, side 5 ft, rear 20 ft, 2 1/2 stories or 35 ft. Two parking spaces per unit (240-64B)
value.note: Not an ADU listing. A building type. Whether an existing house may be altered into a two-family dwelling is not stated

value.name: Two-family dwelling (C-3)
value.conditions: A two-family dwelling is 'A residential building containing two independent dwelling units, each having a separate entrance, and which is the only principal building on the lot' (240-8). C-3 gives one lot minimum for all uses: 5,500 sq ft with public sewer, 21,780 sq ft without, 50 ft wide. Front 25 ft, side 10 ft, rear 30 ft, impervious cover 70%. Two parking spaces per unit (240-64B)
value.note: Not an ADU listing. A building type. Whether an existing house may be altered into a two-family dwelling is not stated

value.name: Two-family dwelling in a planned district (SD residential category, IHPD)
value.conditions: Two-family dwellings are a use by right in the SD District's residential land use category, once an illustrative site plan assigning the category to the lot is approved by conditional use and a subdivision plat is recorded (240-34G(1)). The Interstate Highway Planned Development Overlay permits them in its single-family and combination residential categories, on land east of Morganza Road (240-38F)

requires.condition: The lot is assigned the residential land use category on an approved illustrative site plan

value.note: Not an ADU listing. A building type inside a planned development

districts_read_no_listing.note: R-4 is for mobile home parks. C-2 permits townhouses and garden apartments by right and new single-family dwellings only by conditional use (240-29C(4))

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A second residential building on the lot is barred (240-46)

value.where: Lot up to 1/2 acre: accessory structures at most 35% of the house's livable space or 625 sq ft, whichever is less
Lot of 1/2 to 0.9 acre: at most 50% of the house or 1,025 sq ft
Lot of 1 to 2.9 acres: at most 75% of the house or 1,600 sq ft
Lot of 3 to 4.5 acres: at most 100% of the house or 2,000 sq ft
Lot of 5 acres and above: at most 200% of the house

C-1's own figures for other uses: 20,000 sq ft, front 45 ft, side 25 ft (100 ft next to a residence), impervious 70%
